about: The soft-tissue plugin's records: published fibrin values (open, in the package), Lohr et al. 2025's raw pure-shear clot data (CC0, in the package), a placeholder gel, and a placeholder for a lab's private data (its own licence, referenced, never shipped).

assets.name: softtissue_fibrin_plasma
assets.credit: values from Tutwiler et al. 2020 (Sci. Adv. 6:eabc0496) and 2021 (Acta Biomater. 131:355); record by the plugin's authors

assets.name: softtissue_gel_placeholder
assets.credit: placeholder values by the plugin's authors

assets.name: softtissue.lohr2025_pure_shear
